caption: A close-up frames the back of a fair-skinned hand against a dark gray textured backdrop, four fingers rising vertically and a thumb resting at the lower right, with the leftmost finger and thumb showing long manicured nails in a nude base with pale ends. A solitaire ring sits on the second finger from the left, its thin pale-metal band holding a large round brilliant-cut clear stone aloft in four prongs. Throughout, the stone's internal reflections shift continuously, bright white flashes and small points of colored fire surfacing at different facets as the light-to-stone angle shifts. The hand drifts subtly, the ring moving a little upward and to the right while more of the band's left side emerges as a dark reflective surface. The thumb at the lower right turns slightly in step with this gentle repositioning of the whole hand. Otherwise the muted background remains constant. The sparkle patterns keep rearranging on the single stone, neither starting nor settling.
relations: As the light-to-stone angle shifts, white flashes and colored fire move across the brilliant-cut facets.
The hand's subtle drift moves the ring upward-right, revealing more of the band's left side as a dark reflective surface.
The thumb rotates slightly in step with the whole hand's gentle repositioning.
The dark gray textured backdrop stays constant while the stone's sparkle patterns keep rearranging.
